problem: Apple Silicon helper carried from v0.1.208 in v0.1.237
fix: Cross-build arm64 on the Intel Mac and verify it with lipo and a signature check instead of a native run. Also fail the release when a platform is carried for more than 3 releases.
peopleReason: no table records helper architecture; 0 feedback rows from v0.1.208 in 24 h

problem: Database pool runs out of connections at deploy time; 20 timeouts at the 13:54Z v0.1.238 deploy
fix: Limit startup catch-up work while a machine starts. Give the workspace-member and chat-list queries a time limit or their own pool.

problem: Each deploy refuses requests and cuts request bodies
fix: Send traffic to a new machine only after its readiness check passes, and drain the old one before it stops.

problem: Free-agent catch-up cannot observe about 30 machines after a deploy
fix: Back off on a Fly 429, and retry the check after the machine starts.

problem: Android 0.2.22 crashes at native load on x86_64 (libc++_shared.so missing)
fix: Package lib/x86_64/libc++_shared.so in the AAB, or drop x86_64 from abiFilters.

problem: Scheduled loop sessions are told a checkout exists but have none; workspace tool works
fix: Create the checkout before a scheduled turn starts, or make the setup text say "call workspace".

problem: Session setup reports Squire CONNECTION_CLOSED while the registry route works
fix: Drop or correct the notice when the registry route serves the tools.

problem: Three loop procedures contradict loops-contract on old-build drops and open questions
fix: Rewrite the three procedures to defer to loops-contract.

problem: Nightly release runs no full checks (--full-checks never passed); 3rd night without results
fix: The nightly trigger passes --full-checks, or the nightly makes full checks the default. Then record the result path in release.json.

problem: Grader computes truthfulness but never applies it to a sample's pass
fix: A sample passes only if pass && truthfulness !== false. Add a test with that reply.

problem: No authenticated latency fixture; 26 taps and 45 routes unmeasured on 5723a931
fix: Create a saved reviewer session and a disposable workspace for the loop, then time each tap from input to visible result.

problem: Composer command caches pass through draft hook and chat surface; mean 80.4 files per PR touching top 3 app hotspots
fix: Give command discovery, its caches and its changes one controller beside the suggestions hook, with named actions.
